items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: The interviewee interrupts the interviewer's story about Willie to change the subject, indicating no personal connection or direct interaction with Willie is being discussed by the interviewee.

ctx.x: He got that in Burmese, man, that woman had him alive.

Yeah, you know, and then kill him that boy up there. I bought his boy up there. He was coming to Cairo to see me. And I take his car and go over the miles to this big guy in Memphis. He owned all that property. He didn't buy him two cases, get him two cases of whiskey, get him dead. Willie would put me ten or fifteen dollars. The man was wrecking the money after this woman dead. Everything turned over to him.
Excuse me, I want to go back to that Hatchet. I'm interested in him. There was only one Hatchet in Memphis, as far as you know. All of a Hatchet in Memphis.
